question: When did The Simpson's episode air that introduced the character Nelson Muntz?

results.title: Nelson Muntz
results.text: Nelson Mandela Muntz is a fictional character and the lead school bully from the animated TV series "The Simpsons". He is voiced by Nancy Cartwright. Nelson was introduced in Season 1's "Bart the General" as an antagonist but later turned into a on-and-off friend of Bart Simpson. He is well known for his signature mocking laugh "Ha-ha!"

results.title: Lisa's Date with Density
results.text: "Lisa's Date with Density" is the seventh episode of "The Simpsons"<nowiki>'</nowiki> eighth season. It originally aired on the Fox network in the United States on December 15, 1996. It was written by Mike Scully and directed by Susie Dietter. The episode sees Lisa develop a crush on Nelson Muntz, which eventually leads to Lisa and Nelson dating.

results.title: Bart the General
results.text: "Bart the General" is the fifth episode of "The Simpsons"<nowiki>'</nowiki> first season. It originally aired on the Fox network in the United States on February 4, 1990. The episode deals with Bart's troubles with the bully Nelson Muntz. Bart chooses to go to war with Nelson uniting the neighborhood children against him. The episode was written by John Swartzwelder and directed by David Silverman.
